signature.format: detached signature over canonical UTF-8 JSON bytes
signature.scope: declared packet scope plus exact digest binding
signature.authority_provenance: external signed authority record; currently typed_absent

delivery_channel.receipt_binding: ack digest and accepted object digest equal request bindings
delivery_channel.retry: only channel-declared bounded retry with same idempotency key
delivery_channel.idempotency: same key plus object digest yields same decision or explicit replay/rejected result
delivery_channel.expiry: endpoint, policy, key, certificate, trusted time, nonce and receipt validity expiry requires fresh request and recheck

common_binding.recovery_trigger: real owner supplies complete signed package and independently verifiable raw receipt; unchanged inputs do not create a new AD

packets.title: Independent witness and authority intake
packets.separation: must be independent of witness, PKI, source and environment providers
packets.formats: UTF-8 canonical JSON; SHA-256 lowercase hex; RFC3339 trusted times; detached signature; certificate/reference fields are required but currently typed_absent
packets.authority_provenance: signed witness qualification and authority-channel owner record; authoritative source and authority_ref typed_absent
packets.delivery: endpoint/transport/authentication typed_absent; request must remain not_sent
packets.ack: signed ack bound to request_id, idempotency_key, canonical_object_sha256 and receipt_sha256
reject_if: unknown endpoint owner or unverified channel
packets.recovery_trigger: named independent witness and channel owner provide signed intake/ack package and a second Luna verifies it

packets.title: PKI, trust root, certificate, revocation, trusted-time and replay security
packets.separation: must not be the source implementer or intake witness; verifier is independently reviewed
packets.formats: DER/PEM chain plus signed canonical JSON; SHA-256 fingerprints; RFC3161 or equivalent trusted-time token; CRL/OCSP response with thisUpdate/nextUpdate; explicit algorithm/policy versions
packets.authority_provenance: signed PKI inventory, issuer chain and verifier-policy release; all real authority refs currently typed_absent
packets.delivery: security authority channel endpoint and owner typed_absent; no credential is requested or stored
packets.ack: security receipt must bind request digest, key/certificate fingerprints, revocation as-of time, trusted time and nonce
reject_if: replay, nonce reuse, sequence rollback or duplicate key
packets.recovery_trigger: PKI owner supplies complete chain, signed policy, fresh revocation/time evidence and verifier receipt; independent reviewer rechecks before S3/T0

packets.title: Source, four-axis and G2 mapping authority
packets.separation: source owner cannot self-attest authority; candidate and evidence bindings require independent review
packets.formats: Exact locator plus lowercase SHA-256; versioned canonical JSON; all layer/axis candidate IDs must equal; signed declaration with detached signature and receipt digest
packets.authority_provenance: candidate-bound signed source inventory and versioned G2 mapping registry; current authority/source refs typed_absent; AD55/AD56 remain historical only
packets.delivery: authoritative source channel typed_absent; no local promotion or source mutation
packets.ack: ack binds every layer/axis/G2 hash, candidate ID, revision, version and canonical object digest
reject_if: foreign, stale, duplicate or missing layer/axis
AD55/AD56 historical record used as authority
packets.recovery_trigger: source/G2 authority provides complete signed candidate closure; independent Luna recomputes hashes and rechecks before T0

packets.title: Reproducible environment, SBOM and binary provenance
packets.separation: provider must be independent of candidate source owner and solver operator
packets.formats: Machine-readable manifest; each path/byte hash lowercase SHA-256; lock/build/channel versions; SPDX/CycloneDX SBOM; signed publisher provenance; deterministic redaction ledger for non-sensitive environment values
packets.authority_provenance: candidate-bound environment receipt plus signed publisher/SBOM/license records; current provider, endpoint and authority refs typed_absent
packets.delivery: provider channel typed_absent; no credentials or binary download requested in this preparation package
packets.ack: ack binds candidate, source revision, import/package/artifact map digest, runtime paths/hashes, SBOM and receipt digest
reject_if: environment changed after request or receipt stale
packets.recovery_trigger: provider supplies complete candidate-bound closure and signed receipt; independent reviewer compares hashes and only then schedules recheck
